text.p: Cargolux said it had joined the International Air Transport Association (IATA).

"Becoming an active member of the "House of Lords" of the aviation industry represents a logical step for Cargolux in view of the growing importance of the air cargo industry," the all-cargo airline said in a statement.
Quoting IATA forecasts, Cargolux added that with an estimated yearly increase of seven percent until 2015, the air cargo market showed an even better growth rate than for passenger traffic.
Last year, Cargolux joined the Association of European Airlines (AEA).
Cargolux is to take delivery of an additional two Boeing 747-400Fs during ther second half of 1997 taking its fleet to five.
The Luxembourg-based airline also operates four 747-200Fs. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
